pick_implementation.title: Connect Strava Automation
pick_implementation.description: Use a Strava API app created for this integration. If you also use another Strava integration, give each a separate app. Activity read access is required; writes and profile access enable automation and gear features. New accounts start in preview mode.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect your Strava account
reauth_confirm.description: Authorize the same athlete using the same Strava API app. Your existing options will be preserved.

menu_options.new_account: Connect with a separate Strava API app

migrate.title: Select the existing Strava connection
migrate.description: Reuse its API app and authorization. No connection changes until you confirm. If Activity Tools is installed, pause its automations and disable it first.

migration_confirm.title: Transfer this Strava connection
migration_confirm.description: This pauses ha_strava before transferring OAuth ownership. Your old entry remains disabled for rollback. The new integration starts in preview mode. Custom automations and provider sensors are not automatically migrated.

data.confirm_pause: Pause ha_strava and transfer this connection

abort.missing_activity_scope: Activity read access was not granted. Reconnect and allow activity access.
abort.invalid_account: Strava did not return a valid athlete identity. No account was saved.
abort.invalid_auth: Strava rejected the authorization. Reconnect your account.
abort.cannot_connect: Unable to verify your Strava account right now. Try again later.
abort.wrong_account: Authorize the same athlete as the existing connection. Nothing was changed.
abort.wrong_application: Use the same Strava API app as the existing connection. Nothing was changed.

error.unsupported_source: This connection does not expose a supported native HA OAuth session. Reconnect it before migrating.
error.source_not_loaded: Enable the old connection first, or resume its recorded migration.
error.dependent_integration_active: Pause dependent Activity Tools automations, let active jobs finish, and disable Activity Tools before migrating.
error.migration_credentials_missing: The application credentials for the paused migration are missing. Restore them before resuming.
error.migration_scope_unknown: The existing granted permissions could not be verified. Reauthorize the old provider or use fresh consent before migrating. The source has not been paused.
error.migration_auth_invalid: The existing authorization could not be verified. Reconnect the old provider before migrating.
error.wrong_account: The authenticated athlete changed or does not match this connection. Nothing was transferred.
error.already_configured: This athlete already has a Strava Automation connection.
error.migration_credentials_conflict: Conflicting app credentials exist. Resolve them before transferring this connection.
error.migration_pause_failed: The old connection could not be paused safely. No target was created.
error.migration_storage_failed: The migration record could not be saved. The old connection was restored.
error.migration_confirmation_required: Confirm pausing the old connection before proceeding.
error.shared_application_migration: This API app is shared with another local account. Give each integration its own API app before migrating.
error.migration_subscription_unknown: The existing remote callback could not be matched to this connection. The old connection has not been paused. Verify its webhook configuration before retrying.

init.title: Strava Automation settings
init.description: Choose track shoes from this Strava account. Changes apply immediately. Preview only blocks every Strava write, including queued jobs. Shoes are assigned only to a confidently identified workout on a track. {shoe_catalog_status}

data.reauthorize_strava: Request Strava reauthorization (profile and activity editing)

error.shoe_catalog_unavailable: Could not load your Strava shoes. Existing choices are kept; retry when the Strava account is available.
error.invalid_shoes: Choose an active shoe from this Strava account.
